CONTINENTAL EDITION / 004

A working catalog, not a completed encyclopedia.

Read exactly what is integrated and what remains before a live commercial launch.

Included in this build

796 trip profiles, of which 550 belong to the broad North America collection. All 507 production entries are integrated, not merely held in a spreadsheet. There are 50 U.S. state, 13 Canadian province/territory and 15 Mexican state landing pages. Six continents have working regional navigation and downloadable editorial queues.

Not complete

479 preparation frameworks await local source verification. Ten guides were individually researched in this release; the collection has no independent local-expert sign-off. Amazon links are category searches without an affiliate tracking tag unless the owner configures one. Exact product selection and live inventory are not connected.

Not deployed by a generated file

The standalone HTML and source package are local review artifacts. Publishing requires an authorized site and production origin. A deploy-ready source package is not a live website.

Bookings and saved plans

Plans save in the browser; shares contain snapshots. Inquiries are drafts. There is no native booking, payment, escrow or confirmed operator inventory in this release.

Scene images

Our scene images are AI-generated illustrations created with GPT Image. They show representative water environments, not verified views of named destinations.
